name: Starfire High-Court
identity: Angelic starlight elves: few, fast, precise. They strike, then glide out of reach.

rules.name: Solar Grace
rules.description: Every unit has [FLY]. After a unit finishes its Shoot or Fight action it may glide 3″, ending outside Engagement Range. This is the only post-action movement in the game.

rules.name: Gamble — Overcharged Dawnstone
rules.description: Shatter a unit's gem for TWO effects at once; that unit can no longer glide for the rest of the battle. (Risk: tempo / mobility.)

detachments.name: Court of Blades
detachments.playstyle: Melee aristocracy: Dancers and raid lord dive, kill and glide away.

rules.name: Dance of Blades
rules.description: Units that glided last activation get +1 to Hit in melee this activation.

enhancements.name: Starsteel Edge
enhancements.description: **High Star-Regent** only. The bearer's melee critical wounds trigger on 5+.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Dawn
enhancements.description: **Star-Seer** only. Melee attacks against the bearer get −1 to Hit.

stratagems.name: Lightning Riposte
stratagems.effect: It gains [STRIKE FIRST] against that charger.

stratagems.name: Starlight Sidestep
stratagems.turn: A unit is declared as a Charge target
stratagems.effect: Glide 3″ backward; the charge may fail.

detachments.name: Prism Host
detachments.playstyle: Ranged precision: Archers mark, the Phoenix and Skiffs delete.

rules.name: Prismatic Link
rules.description: If 2+ Starfire units shoot the same target in a round, the later ones get +1 PEN against it.

enhancements.name: Focusing Crystal
enhancements.description: **Star-Seer** only. The attached unit gets +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Dawn
enhancements.description: **High Star-Regent** only. The bearer re-rolls ranged Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Hunting Light
stratagems.turn: A unit shoots a Rattled target

stratagems.name: Fade from Sight
stratagems.effect: It gains [UNSEEN 12″] until it next activates.

detachments.name: Wind-Rider Host
detachments.playstyle: Speed: jetbike swarms and skiffs grab objectives and never stay in reach.

rules.name: Wind of Stars
rules.description: Sky-Lancers and vehicles glide 6″ instead of 3″.

enhancements.name: Windrunner Sigil
enhancements.description: **High Star-Regent** only. The bearer gets +4″ Move (can join jetbikes).

stratagems.name: Lightning Raid
stratagems.turn: A fast unit ends a Move on an objective
stratagems.effect: It counts double CTRL until the end of the round.

stratagems.name: Contrails
stratagems.turn: A unit is shot after Moving ≥10″
stratagems.effect: −1 to Hit against it for that attack.
